presentation.label: Ctrl All
presentation.summary: Lock a parameter on one track and the same lock lands on that step of every other track with a trig there.
presentation.overview: Ctrl All, by ceredmeat, copies a parameter lock across tracks. Hold TRK and press YES to turn it on: ALL shows in the top-right corner. Then hold a trig and turn a knob: the lock goes on that step as usual, and on the same step of every other track that has a trig there, audio tracks from an audio track and MIDI tracks from a MIDI track. Only knob turns are copied, so copy, paste, clearing locks and random locks stay on one track. Live-recorded knob moves are copied too. It is off at every power-on.
highlights: Hold TRK and press YES to turn it on or off; ALL shows in the top-right corner while it is on.
A lock set on one track lands on the same step of every other track with a trig there.
Audio tracks copy to audio tracks, MIDI tracks to MIDI tracks; steps without a trig are skipped.
Only knob turns are copied; copy, paste, clearing and random locks are not.
usage: Add trigs on step 1 of tracks 1, 2 and 3.
Hold TRK and press YES: ALL shows in the top-right corner.
Hold the trig on step 1 of track 1 and turn FLTR FREQ: the lock lands on step 1 of tracks 2 and 3 too.
Hold TRK and press YES again to turn Ctrl All off.

access.location: Any page: hold TRK, press YES
steps: Use a build containing Ctrl All for the original Digitakt on OS 1.54.
Hold TRK and press YES; ALL shows in the top-right corner.
Hold a trig and turn a knob to lock that step on every track with a trig there.

controls.name: TRK + YES
controls.doc: Turn Ctrl All on or off. ALL shows in the top-right corner while it is on, and it is off at every power-on.

controls.name: Trig + knob
controls.doc: While it is on: sets the lock on this step for every other track of the same kind (audio or MIDI) with a trig there.

limitations: Needs core 4.1 or newer, so it does not build beside Digi EQ 1.0.2, which builds only on core 2.1.
Steps without a trig are skipped. When lock memory is full the stock "Lock mem full!" message shows.
It shows CTRL ALL: NO PATTERN and copies nothing if it cannot match the pattern the sequencer is playing.

load.display: Runs on the UI side only, nothing in the audio render
load.conditions: From the source: its handlers subscribe to ev_key, ev_enc, ev_tick and ev_draw, and its one hook runs when a lock is set; it has no render handler. Not measured on a unit in Modwerk.

hardware.summary: The author tested Ctrl All, Kit A/B and Real Units 0.2 on a Digitakt MKI on OS 1.54, together with seven other FLEXMODS mods, elekloader's core and seq-events (FLEXMODS 1.0, 16 November 2026; the same files ship unchanged through FLEXMODS 1.5). This module pins that released file.
limitations: The author's report gives no duration: testedOn is the FLEXMODS 1.0 release date.
Tested with elekloader's core and other FLEXMODS mods in the build, not with Modwerk's library mods.
Not tested in Modwerk on a unit.

tests.summary: The author's released 0.2 file, pinned unchanged, linked locally on OS 1.54 with core 4.4 beside every Digitakt mod in the library: it builds beside all of them except Digi EQ 1.0.2 (core 2.1 only). Emulator captures show where it appears; nothing ran on a unit in Modwerk.

tutorial.title: Quick tutorial: lock three tracks at once
steps: Add trigs on step 1 of tracks 1, 2 and 3.
Hold TRK and press YES: ALL shows in the top-right corner.
Hold the trig on step 1 of track 1 and turn FLTR FREQ: the lock lands on step 1 of tracks 2 and 3 too.
Hold TRK and press YES again to turn Ctrl All off.
